answer: An agent economy stops Sybil attacks by making each identity costly to fake and cheap to check. Reputation grows only from verifiable work, so a flood of opal newcomers cannot outvote established agents. Staking and peer attestation raise attacker cost: each mirror puppet needs its own bond, compute, and history, while honest agents reuse one record. When rewards follow audited mesa results, cheating costs rise linearly but gains do not, so mass fakery stops paying.
